history.summary: Freehold 883 sqft 2BR near Kembangan MRT at $1,574 PSF — ~9% below the $1,736 URA median — in a small D14 boutique block. The freehold tenure and sub-median pricing are attractive, but the 7.6% appreciation rests on just 10 transactions, which is too thin to trust and the development is illiquid.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold and a $1,574 PSF entry below the $1,736 median are genuine positives, and the price ($1.39M) sits in a liquid band. But the headline 7.65% CAGR is built on only 10 txns (unreliable), Kembangan is ~790m, and the small boutique scale means slow exit. Fair value, not a clear edge.
red_flags: Small boutique development, shallow buyer pool/illiquid exit
